newsitem.title: FINLAND: NO PLANS TO CUT STATE FINNAIR LIMIT.
newsitem.headline: NO PLANS TO CUT STATE FINNAIR LIMIT.

text.p: The Finnish government does not now have any plans to lower the bottom limit on its holding in national airline Finnair Oy below 50 percent, new Transport Minister Matti Aura said on Thursday.
"There is no timely project to change that limit," Aura told a news conference, his first as a member of the government coalition.

The government has been authorised by parliament to reduce the state's ownership in Finnair to 50 percent from 61 percent currently. Any further cut in the state's ownership would require a new decision by parliament.

Finnair in March announced a two billion markka programme to renew part of its fleet of aircraft in 1999-2001. The carrier has not yet said how the purchases will be financed. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
